verdict.rationale: incident.io documents an official remote MCP server that lets any MCP-capable AI assistant connect directly to incident data. Through it an agent can query incidents, analyze alerts, check on-call, and manage escalations, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documented setup/authentication details for connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The incident.io MCP server lets you connect any AI assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol directly to your incident data.
Query incidents, analyze alerts, check who's on call, manage escalations, and run deep operational analysis — all from your existing AI tools.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.incident.io/ai/remote-mcp
